{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trogan Planetary Tourism Board''' was an organization located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. After the [[Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe]] was forced to close, they became responsible for the venue. Since it would require an expensive reconstruction project to convert the [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] into another venue, the Board desperately wanted to sell the now-deserted building.
